SELECT u.USER_NO, u.USER_ID, u.USER_NM, u.EMAIL, u.AUTHOR_ID, /* 권한명 참조 */ (SELECT a.AUTHOR_NM FROM op_author a WHERE a.AUTHOR_ID = u.AUTHOR_ID) as AUTHOR_NM, u.USER_STTUS_CODE, /* 사용자상태코드명 매핑 (GROUP_ID 우선) */ (SELECT c.CODE_NM FROM op_code c WHERE c.GROUP_ID = 'R010050' AND c.CODE = u.USER_STTUS_CODE) as USER_STTUS_NM, u.REGIST_DT, u.REGISTER_NO, /* 등록자명 참조 */ (SELECT r.USER_NM FROM op_user r WHERE r.USER_NO = u.REGISTER_NO) as REGISTER_NM, /* 지역 중분류명 매핑 (GROUP_ID: R010070) */ (SELECT c1.CODE_NM FROM op_code c1 WHERE c1.GROUP_ID = 'R010070' AND c1.CODE = u.AREA_CODE) as AREA_NM, /* 지역 소분류명 매핑 (op_sclas_code 필드명 반영) */ (SELECT c2.SCLAS_NM FROM op_sclas_code c2 WHERE c2.GROUP_ID = 'R010070' AND c2.CODE = u.AREA_CODE AND c2.SCLAS_CODE = u.AREA_SE_CODE_S) as AREA_SE_NM FROM op_user u WHERE 1=1
AND u.USER_STTUS_CODE = #{searchStatus}
AND u.AUTHOR_ID = #{searchAuthor}
AND u.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND u.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (u.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND u.REGIST_DT >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND u.REGIST_DT < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY u.USER_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM op_user u WHERE 1=1
AND u.USER_STTUS_CODE = #{searchStatus}
AND u.AUTHOR_ID = #{searchAuthor}
AND u.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND u.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (u.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR u.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND u.REGIST_DT >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND u.REGIST_DT < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT u.*, (SELECT a.AUTHOR_NM FROM op_author a WHERE a.AUTHOR_ID = u.AUTHOR_ID) as AUTHOR_NM, (SELECT c1.CODE_NM FROM op_code c1 WHERE c1.GROUP_ID = 'R010070' AND c1.CODE = u.AREA_CODE) as AREA_NM, (SELECT c2.SCLAS_NM FROM op_sclas_code c2 WHERE c2.GROUP_ID = 'R010070' AND c2.CODE = u.AREA_CODE AND c2.SCLAS_CODE = u.AREA_SE_CODE_S) as AREA_SE_NM FROM op_user u WHERE u.USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO op_user ( USER_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NM, CTTPC, EMAIL, AREA_CODE, AREA_SE_CODE_S, AREA_SE_CODE_D, USER_STTUS_CODE, AUTHOR_ID, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{userNm}, #{cttpc}, #{email}, #{areaCode}, #{areaSeCodeS}, #{areaSeCodeD}, #{userSttusCode}, #{authorId}, #{registerNo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT AUTHOR_ID, AUTHOR_NM FROM op_author ORDER BY AUTHOR_ID ASC
SELECT CODE, CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDR ASC
